eDNA from Gulf of Mexico Ecosystems and Carbon Cruise 2021 (GOMECC-4)

After sampling, run ~1 L of 5% bleach through tubing lines, then repeat with ~1 L of deionized water. Rinse the 20-L collection carboy 3 times with ~0.5 L DI water (1.5 L total) after sampling. Before the next sample, rinse 20-L carboy 2 times with ~100 mL of sample water (200 mL total).

Bacteria-16S-V4V5-Parada: AmpliTaq Gold 360 Master Mix, Thermo Fisher Scientific
Eukarya-18S-V9-Lane-Medlin: AmpliTaq Gold 360 Master Mix, Thermo Fisher Scientific

Bacteria-16S-V4V5-Parada: PCR reactions were run in triplicate (13.0 µl), with 1 µl of DNA per reaction, 5 µl of AmpliTaq Gold, 6.25 µl of water, and 0.375 µl of each primer (10 µM).
Eukarya-18S-V9-Lane-Medlin: PCR reactions were run in triplicate (13.0 µl), with 1 µl of DNA per reaction, 5 µl of AmpliTaq Gold, 6.5 µl of water, and 0.25 µl of each primer (10 µM).

Bacteria-16S-V4V5-Parada: DreamTaq Hot Start PCR Master Mix (K9012), Thermo Fisher Scientific
Eukarya-18S-V9-Lane-Medlin: DreamTaq Hot Start PCR Master Mix (K9012), Thermo Fisher Scientific

Bacteria-16S-V4V5-Parada: Michigan State University Research Technology Support Facility Genomics Core
Eukarya-18S-V9-Lane-Medlin: Michigan State University Research Technology Support Facility Genomics Core

Bacteria-16S-V4V5-Parada: The Genomics Core performed secondary PCR using dual indexed, Illumina-compatible primers targeting the Fluidigm CS1/CS2 oligomers at the ends of the primary PCR products. Amplicons were batch normalized using Invitrogen SequalPrep DNA Normalization plates and recovered product was pooled. The pool was QC’d and quantified using a combination of Qubit dsDNA HS, Agilent 4200 TapeStation HS DNA1000, and Invitrogen Collibri Library Quantification qPCR assays.
Eukarya-18S-V9-Lane-Medlin: The Genomics Core performed secondary PCR using dual indexed, Illumina-compatible primers targeting the Fluidigm CS1/CS2 oligomers at the ends of the primary PCR products. Amplicons were batch normalized using Invitrogen SequalPrep DNA Normalization plates and recovered product was pooled. The pool was QC’d and quantified using a combination of Qubit dsDNA HS, Agilent 4200 TapeStation HS DNA1000, and Invitrogen Collibri Library Quantification qPCR assays.

Bacteria-16S-V4V5-Parada: PhiX control library was spiked in at 10%.
Eukarya-18S-V9-Lane-Medlin: PhiX control library was spiked in at 10%.

Bacteria-16S-V4V5-Parada: Merged 2 sequencing runs. Removal of ASVs assigned to Chloroplast, Mitochondria, and Eukaryota, and unassigned past the domain level. Removal of control samples and those with < 5000 reads, removed ASVs only observed once.
Eukarya-18S-V9-Lane-Medlin: Removal of ASVs assigned to non-protist taxa, metazoa, and unassigned past the domain level. Removal of control samples and those with < 3000 reads, removed ASVs only observed once.
